# 06 — Lazy-load the editor

## Goal
Readers download only what it takes to read. CodeMirror (the bulk of the entry bundle today) is fetched
only when someone actually starts editing, so shared links open faster, especially on phones.

## Scope / Out of scope
**In:** code-splitting `EditorPane` and every CodeMirror package out of the entry graph; when the chunk may
be requested; loading placeholder; load-failure handling; intent prefetch; build-level verification.
**Out:** editor features (#8–#12), split view layout (#7, which reuses the same async component),
mermaid/diff lazy loading (already lazy: `PreviewPane.vue:17-29`, `useDiff.ts:37`), removing other deps.

## Current state
- `App.vue:15` imports `EditorPane` statically; `EditorPane.vue:3-9` imports `@codemirror/view`, `state`,
  `lang-markdown`, `lang-html`, `language-data`, `commands`, `search`.
- A production build (`vite build`, 2026-10-10) puts CodeMirror in the entry chunk `assets/index-*.js`
  (957 kB, 335 kB gzip): the string `cm-gutters` occurs in it, and `index.html` loads it on every page.
  `@codemirror/language-data` language modes are already separate dynamic chunks. A throwaway trial that only
  swapped the import for `defineAsyncComponent` gave entry 400 kB / `EditorPane-*.js` 557 kB, with no
  `cm-gutters` left in the entry — so the split is mechanically simple.
- `vue-codemirror` is listed in `package.json` but imported nowhere.
- `App.vue:27` already lazy-loads `RevisionsModal` with `defineAsyncComponent` (pattern to reuse).
- `editorRef.value?.scrollToLine(line)` (`App.vue:580-586`) is the only imperative call into the editor.

## Behaviour
1. `EditorPane` is loaded through `defineAsyncComponent(() => import('@/components/EditorPane.vue'))` (or an
   equivalent dynamic import). No module reachable by **static** imports from `src/main.ts` may import
   `@codemirror/*`, `codemirror` or `EditorPane.vue`; type-only imports (`import type`) are allowed.
2. The editor chunk is requested **only** when one of these happens:
   a. the view becomes `edit` or `split` (toggle click, or loading a URL with `?view=edit|split` as an editor);
   b. intent prefetch: pointer enters, or keyboard focus lands on, `view-toggle-edit` / `view-toggle-split`;
   c. a feature that needs the editor API is invoked (e.g. a comment "scroll to" while in edit view — only
      possible after a/b).
   It is never requested on idle, on load of read view, for viewers, for `?embed=1`, pinned revisions, the
   landing page or the library. Prefetch (b) uses the same dynamic import, so the chunk is fetched once.
3. **Placeholder**: while the chunk loads, the editor pane shows `editor-loading` (a skeleton the same size as
   the editor, text "Loading editor…", `aria-busy="true"`). The current markdown is not editable during this
   time and no keystrokes are lost: focus moves into the editor once it mounts. The view toggle already shows
   the target view as pressed.
4. **Failure** (chunk 404 after a redeploy, offline): the pane shows `editor-load-error` with the message
   "Couldn't load the editor" and `editor-load-retry`. Retry re-attempts the import (a fresh `import()` call
   with a cache-busting query is acceptable after a failed one). If the failure looks like a stale deployment
   (chunk 404), the message adds "Reload the page to get the latest version" with `editor-load-reload`.
   Content and unsaved edits are untouched; switching back to read view works.
5. Once loaded, switching read ↔ edit does not re-request the chunk and the editor shows in < 100 ms
   (warm path), preserving content as today. After its first mount the editor instance is **kept alive** (hidden,
   not unmounted) for the lifetime of the open document, so #7 tabs and #8 history survive view switches (#8 rule 7).
   The `EditorToolbar` (00 §3.3) and every `src/editor/*` module belong to the lazy chunk.
6. Behaviour of `scrollToLine`, autosave, Ctrl/Cmd+S, comment decorations and selection events is unchanged
   after the editor mounts. Calls made before mount are no-ops (never throw).
7. Unused `vue-codemirror` is removed from `package.json` dependencies.
8. The CodeMirror CSS (generated by CodeMirror at runtime) and any editor-specific app CSS ship with the
   lazy chunk, not the entry CSS, where Vite allows (scoped styles of `EditorPane.vue` go with its chunk).
9. A repeatable check script `npm run check:lazy-editor` (or a vitest test that reads `dist/`) builds or reads
   the production build and fails if the entry chunk **or any chunk it statically imports or modulepreloads**
   contains the marker strings `cm-gutters` or `cm-content`.

## Acceptance criteria
AC-06.1 Given the dev server and a fresh context, When a shared markdown doc is opened in read view and left idle 5 s (no hover on the view toggle) Then no network request URL matches `/codemirror|EditorPane/i`.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.2 Given AC-06.1 When `view-toggle-edit` is clicked Then a request matching `/codemirror|EditorPane/i` is made, `editor-loading` is visible until `.cm-editor` appears, and `.cm-content` contains the doc text.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.3 Given a viewer opens a doc (and separately `/library`, `/`, `/d/<id>@<hash>`, `?embed=1`) and scrolls the whole page Then no request matches `/codemirror|EditorPane/i`.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.4 Given an editor opens `/d/<id>?view=edit` Then the editor loads without any further interaction and becomes editable.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.5 Given read view When the pointer hovers `view-toggle-edit` (no click) Then exactly one editor-chunk request is made; clicking afterwards makes no additional request for it.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.6 Given the editor chunk request is aborted (route returns 404) When `view-toggle-edit` is clicked Then `editor-load-error` and `editor-load-retry` appear, the rendered doc text is unchanged, and clicking `view-toggle-read` shows the reader; after un-blocking, `editor-load-retry` mounts the editor.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.7 Given a production build Then the `check:lazy-editor` script passes, and the entry JS chunk referenced by `dist/index.html` does not contain `cm-gutters`.   [verify: unit]
AC-06.8 Given a production build Then the entry JS chunk is at least 40% smaller (bytes) than the 957 kB baseline recorded in Current state.   [verify: unit]
AC-06.9 Given edit → read → edit Then the second switch makes no editor-chunk request and `.cm-editor` is visible within 100 ms.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.10 Given the editor has mounted When the user types, presses Ctrl/Cmd+S, and uses a comment's "scroll to" in edit view (review doc) Then autosave, save and scroll behave as before (existing durable-sync e2e suite passes).   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.11 Given a `?filePath=` fixture When the user clicks Edit and types immediately after the placeholder appears Then the keystrokes typed after `.cm-editor` mounts are in the doc and nothing typed during loading corrupts the content.   [verify: e2e]
AC-06.12 Given `package.json` Then `vue-codemirror` is not a dependency and `npm run build` succeeds.   [verify: unit]

## Test hooks (data-testid list) and API/MCP contract changes
`editor-loading`, `editor-load-error`, `editor-load-retry`, `editor-load-reload`; relies on `view-toggle-edit`, `view-toggle-split`
(#2/#7), `.cm-editor`, `.cm-content`. Script `check:lazy-editor` in `package.json`. No API/MCP changes.

## Edge cases the adversarial verifier must try
- Slow 3G throttling: double-click Edit, toggle Read/Edit rapidly while loading (one request, final view wins, no duplicate editors).
- Keyboard-only: Tab onto `view-toggle-edit` (focus prefetch) then Enter.
- Touch device: tap Edit (no hover) still loads; no prefetch on scroll.
- Redeploy simulation: chunk hash 404 → reload hint shown.
- HTML doc edit (lang-html path) and markdown with fenced languages (language-data chunks load lazily inside the editor).
- Split view (#7) loads the same chunk and shows its own placeholder.

## Dependencies on other items (by number) and files likely touched
Needs #2 (views, capability — viewers never get the toggle; before #23 the only viewers are pinned revisions/embeds,
00 §1.2) and #4 (`?view=`). e2e: tests that click Edit and type must wait for `.cm-content` (00 §11). #7 split view and #8–#12 editor features live in
the lazy chunk and must not add static CodeMirror imports elsewhere (e.g. shared keymap helpers must be imported only from
lazy modules). Files: `src/components/DocView.vue` (async component, keep-alive), `src/components/EditorPane.vue` (unchanged API),
`src/components/ViewToggle.vue` (prefetch on hover/focus), `package.json`, new `scripts/check-lazy-editor.mjs` (or `tests/build/lazy-editor.test.ts`).

## Decisions
- Intent prefetch on hover/focus is allowed: it hides most of the load delay and is still triggered only by an editor about to edit.
- Build-level marker check (`cm-gutters`) in addition to the network check: network tests can miss a static import that happens to be cached.
- 40% entry-size reduction threshold: CodeMirror plus its language packages are well over half of today's entry chunk; a weaker split would fail it.
